_comment: 由 tools/zh/zh.py text-extract 生成；zh 为空表示未翻译（回退原文）。控制码沿用 <LINE>/<DONE>/<PLAYER> 等写法，{{n}} 为不可翻译的占位命令，必须原样保留。

AzaleaTownSignText.en: Azalea Town<LINE>Where People and<PARA>#mon Live in<LINE>Happy Harmony<DONE>
AzaleaTownSignText.zh: 桧皮镇<LINE>人与宝可梦<PARA>和谐共处<LINE>的城镇<DONE>

AzaleaGymSignText.zh: 桧皮镇<LINE>宝可梦道馆<CONT>馆主：阿笔<PARA>会走路的<LINE>虫宝可梦<CONT>百科全书<DONE>

SlowpokeWellSignText.en: Slowpoke Well<PARA>Also known as the<LINE>Rainmaker Well.<PARA>Locals believe<LINE>that a Slowpoke's<CONT>yawn summons rain.<PARA>Records show that<LINE>a Slowpoke's yawn<PARA>ended a drought<LINE>400 years ago.<DONE>
SlowpokeWellSignText.zh: 呆呆兽之井<PARA>又名<LINE>唤雨之井。<PARA>当地人相信<LINE>呆呆兽的哈欠<CONT>能唤来雨水。<PARA>据记载，<LINE>400年前，<PARA>呆呆兽的哈欠<PARA>终结了一场<CONT>大旱。<DONE>

AzaleaTownAdvancedTipsSignText.en: Advanced Tips!<PARA>The Switch battle<LINE>style lets you<PARA>know which #-<LINE>mon an opponent is<CONT>about to send out,<PARA>but the Predict<LINE>style does not!<DONE>
AzaleaTownAdvancedTipsSignText.zh: 进阶提示！<PARA>切换式对战<LINE>能让你知道<PARA>对手接下来<LINE>要派出的<CONT>宝可梦，<PARA>但预知式<LINE>就不行！<DONE>

AzaleaTownYoungsterText.en: Cut through Azalea<LINE>and you'll be in<CONT>Ilex Forest.<PARA>But these skinny<LINE>trees make it<PARA>impossible to get<LINE>through.<PARA>The Charcoal Man's<LINE>#mon can Cut<CONT>down trees.<DONE>
AzaleaTownYoungsterText.zh: 穿过桧皮镇<LINE>就是<CONT>桐树林。<PARA>可这些细树<LINE>挡住了去路，<PARA>根本<LINE>过不去。<PARA>烧炭人的<LINE>宝可梦会<CONT>砍树。<DONE>

AzaleaTownRocket1Text.en: It's unsafe to go<LINE>in there, so I'm<CONT>standing guard.<PARA>Aren't I a good<LINE>Samaritan?<DONE>
AzaleaTownRocket1Text.zh: 里面很危险，<LINE>所以我在<CONT>这里站岗。<PARA>我是不是<LINE>很乐于助人？<DONE>

AzaleaTownRocket2Text.en: Do you know about<LINE>SlowpokeTail? I<CONT>heard it's tasty!<PARA>Aren't you glad I<LINE>told you that?<DONE>
AzaleaTownRocket2Text.zh: 你知道<LINE>呆呆兽的尾巴吗？<PARA>听说很好吃！<PARA>我告诉你，<LINE>是不是该<CONT>谢谢我？<DONE>

AzaleaTownKurtText.en: Could you go see<LINE>why Ilex Forest is<CONT>so restless?<DONE>
AzaleaTownKurtText.zh: 你能去看看<LINE>桐树林为什么<CONT>这么不安吗？<DONE>
